title: Gemini now lets you edit the files it creates right in the chat
description: Back in April, Google's Gemini gained the ability to generate files for you, from Docs and Sheets to PDFs and Markdown. Until now, though, if you wanted to tweak what it came up with, you had to download or export the file first. Today, Google is fixing that by letting you preview and edit documents, PDFs, presentations, spreadsheets, code, and more right in the Gemini app. Files can be expanded to full screen, where you can type your edits directly, highlight text to ask questions about it, have Gemini refine the text or visuals, or ask it follow-up questions. There is a catch,...

title: vivo S70's full camera details emerge in new leak
description: Last week, a rumour claimed that vivo was preparing to launch the V70 in China with a 64MP Sony periscope telephoto camera and support for a teleconverter. Now, a new leak has revealed the handset's complete camera specifications. According to tipster Digital Chat Station, the vivo V70 will feature a 50MP primary rear sensor and an 8MP ultrawide camera alongside the 64MP periscope telephoto unit. vivo S60 also offers a triple-rear camera setup. The tipster also revealed that the phone will feature a horizontally aligned large rear camera module, likely similar to the vivo...

title: The Nokia 2360 Flip is a dual-display feature phone with an SOS button
description: HMD has unveiled the Nokia 2360 Flip, its latest feature phone with a clamshell design and the Family Assist feature. Designed with school students and senior citizens in mind, the phone features dual displays and a dedicated SOS button. The Nokia 2360 Flip's main highlight is its Family Assist feature, which allows family members to remotely manage the device. They can add contacts, adjust volume levels, set reminders, and access other settings remotely. It also features a dedicated SOS button on the rear panel. Pressing it calls a pre-set emergency contact and sends an alert...

title: The new OLED iPad mini runs Geekbench, here are the results
description: Apple unveiled the iPad mini (2026) with an OLED screen and the A20 Pro chipset on Monday, and the first units will reach buyers on November 6. Ahead of that, one has already been run through Geekbench 7, so we now have a good idea of how it performs. The listing is for the iPad19,2, which is the Wi-Fi + Cellular model, and it shows 3,879 points in the single-core test and 9,870 in multi-core. The CPU has five cores (two performance and three efficiency ones), with the performance cores clocked at 4.93GHz. That means this is one of the 128GB or 256GB models, which get a binned A20 Pro with...

title: Motorola confirms the Signature 27's exact launch date
description: Motorola first showed off the Signature 27 during Qualcomm's Snapdragon Summit back in September, but it's been holding back the full specs and pricing ever since. Yesterday, its Indian website said the phone is "coming this November", and now the company has narrowed that down to an exact date: November 5. Here's what we already know. The Signature 27 is powered by the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 chipset, cooled by an ArcticMesh system with a vapor chamber that's 40% larger than the previous generation's. There's a 50MP Sony Lytia 910 main camera with OIS and a 200MP periscope...

title: Oppo Find X10 Ultra could be heading for a chipset switch
description: The Oppo Find X10 Ultra's full camera setup leaked earlier this week, but what about the chip that will be powering it? The Find X9 Ultra launched back in April with the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset, so you'd expect its successor to stick with Qualcomm. That might not necessarily be the case. Today, a tipster on Weibo said that a Dimensity 9600 Pro version of the Ultra is being tested with customized imaging algorithms. This image processing customization would presumably be in service of Oppo's Lumo True Image Engine. Oppo Find X9 Ultra Before you start thinking this is a done...

title: iPhone Air 2 specs surface again in new leak
description: The iPhone Air 2 is expected to launch alongside the iPhone 18 and iPhone 18e next spring. While recent rumours have pointed to a slimmer design and dual-rear cameras, a new leak has once again detailed the main specs. Well-known tipster Digital Chat Station has shared the upgrades expected to come with the iPhone Air 2. According to the tipster, the iPhone will sport a 6.55-inch flat OLED display with a standard aspect ratio, 120Hz refresh rate, and 1.5K+ resolution. It is also said to come with the 2nm A20-series chipset that was introduced with the iPhone 18 Pro series and the...

title: T-Mobile CEO rules out letting SpaceX's Starlink Mobile run on its network
description: SpaceX has made no secret of its plans to enter the US telecom market, and earlier this month it bought more spectrum to turn Starlink Mobile into a full-fledged carrier. It's also reportedly in talks to get access to at least 80,000 cell sites across the country. A quicker way to get started would be an MVNO deal with an existing carrier - basically, renting capacity on someone else's network. Now, T-Mobile CEO Srini Gopalan has made it clear that this won't be happening with his company. Asked about it during T-Mobile's Q3 earnings call yesterday, Gopalan said the carrier's approach to...

title: Sony goes transparent with PS5 Prism Collection
description: Sony announced its Prism Collection DualSense 5 controllers and console cover plates. They come in three bold colors: Flare Orange, Emerald Green, and Graphite Gray. The new accessories feature transparent elements that showcase part of their internals. The top halves of the plates reveal the console’s fan, while the controllers are even more striking, as you get to see all of their key components and switches. Prism Collection DualSense 5 controllers The accompanying press release does not specify whether the console covers will be compatible with all PS5 models...

title: The Ultrahuman Ring Pro is on sale across the US online and in stores
description: The Ultrahuman Ring Pro is now on sale in the US. You can find it online on the company’s own store, on BestBuy.com, Target.com and Walmart.com. If you buy it from Ultrahuman.com, you can get a 10% discount using our code GSMPRO. The code should be applied automatically if you use the highlighted link – this drops the price from $479 to $431.10 – but we’re adding the text code just in case. title: Trump Mobile T1 Phone teardown video confirms everyone's suspicions
description: After having been announced all the way back in June of last year, the Trump Mobile T1 Phone finally became available in June of this year, with a new design and changed specs that still aren't anywhere near high-end. Oh, and the price has jumped from $499 to $749 at some point since the release. For that amount of cash you get a 6.78-inch AMOLED screen with a 120Hz refresh rate, the Snapdragon 7 Gen 3 chipset, 512GB of storage, a 50MP main camera, an 8MP ultrawide, and 50MP telephoto camera with 2x optical zoom, a 50MP selfie camera, and a 5,000 mAh battery. title: OnePlus Ace 7 and Ace 7 Pro announced with cooling fans and 185Hz displays
description: OnePlus announced the Ace 7 series, comprising two phones: the Ace 7 and the Ace 7 Pro. Some believe that the vanilla Ace 7 is going to be rebadged as the OnePlus 16R for markets outside of China. The party trick of the two phones is that they feature fans to keep the powerful chipsets running cooler during long gaming sessions. After all, the Ace 7 series are gaming-oriented devices. Let's start with the OnePlus Ace 7 Pro, which is powered by the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset paired with either 12GB or 16GB of RAM. The available storage options start at 256GB and cap at 1TB, which...

title: Amazon launches the Echo Show 16, Echo Time, Alexa Photo Frame, and new Echo speakers
description: Amazon has refreshed its Alexa hardware lineup with five new devices: the redesigned Echo Show 16 smart display, a new Echo Dot, the Echo Studio with Home Camera, the Echo Time smart clock, and the Alexa Photo Frame. All of them come with the latest version of Alexa+, which the company says can now hold more natural conversations, ask clarifying questions, and handle complex multi-step requests. As a reminder, Alexa+ is free for Prime members. Compared to the Echo Show 15, the Echo Show 16 has a 16-inch Full HD screen with 10% more viewing area, set in an anodized aluminum frame that's...

title: The Samsung W27 goes official in China
description: Samsung has unveiled the W27, its latest W-series foldable smartphone, in China. The handset is essentially a Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra with a luxury makeover, featuring gold accents and a more premium finish. The Samsung W27 sports a dual-tone design in red and blue, colors traditionally associated with Chinese culture. The gold finish extends to the frame, hinge, rear camera module, and camera lens rings. The rear panel also features the signature gold ‘Heart to the World’ logo. Both the front and rear panels are protected by Corning Gorilla Glass Ceramic 3. Samsung is also bundling...

title: Honor X9e s launched
description: Honor’s latest addition to its X-series is now official with the Honor X9e s. The device is already available across the Middle East with a starting price of SAR 1,499 ($400) for the single 8/256GB trim. It may look familiar, and there’s good reason why: the X9e s is a rebadged Honor Turbo, which came out back in August. Honor X9e s The X9e s comes in the same Dawn Orange, Midnight Black and Glacier White colors. It’s built around a 6.79 AMOLED screen with FHD+ resolution, a 120Hz refresh rate and 1,800 nits peak brightness. You also get Qualcomm’s Snapdragon 6 Gen 4 chip with 8GB...

title: Apple reportedly lowered its iPhone Duo QA standards to get more units out in time
description: There has been no shortage of controversy surrounding the iPhone Duo and more specifically its delicate hinge mechanism. We’ve seen numerous reports of inner display damage with Apple openly acknowledging the issue, claiming it only affects “a small number of iPhone Duo units” and that affected users should contact Apple for a replacement. Image source: Vishnu_RK (Reddit) But a report from Chinese outlet Jiemian News suggests Apple had “lowered its quality inspection standards” to get more Duo units out to retailers ahead of the holiday period. title: New certification corroborates Samsung Galaxy S27's charging speed
description: The Samsung Galaxy S7, bearing model code SM-S9520, bagged 3C certification last month, which revealed it will support 25W charging speed. Now, multiple Samsung devices, believed to be the Galaxy S27, have been certified by Denmark's UL Solutions (Demko), corroborating the charging speed. Samsung Galaxy S27's leaked render (Source: OnLeaks and Android Headlines) The certificates for all models list ratings of 9V DC and 2.77A, which is 24.93W, meaning the devices will be advertised as supporting 25W charging. title: Wobble to launch its second smartphone, the Speed 5G
description: Wobble, an Indian smartphone brand owned by Indkal Technologies, is preparing to launch its second handset, the Speed 5G. The company debuted its first smartphone, the Wobble One, in November last year. The company has shared a couple of teasers on social media, confirming the upcoming phone’s launch in India and offering a glimpse of its rear design. Based on the teaser images, the Wobble Speed 5G will feature a circular rear camera module, replacing the square-shaped setup on the Wobble One. The upcoming smartphone is expected to be priced under INR 20,000 and is likely to...

title: Here's when the iQOO 16 is rumored to launch outside China
description: The iQOO 16 went official in China back in late September, and earlier this month we heard that it's headed to India too. Today, a tipster on X claims to know exactly when that will happen. According to him, the iQOO 16 will launch in India around December 15-17. If that's right, Indian fans will have to wait quite a bit longer than last year. The iQOO 15 was announced in China on October 20, 2025, and its international rollout started with India on November 26, a little over five weeks later. This time around, the gap would be closer to two and a half months. The big question...

title: Oppo Find X10 and Find X10 Pro Max go on sale in India
description: The Oppo Find X10 and Find X10 Pro Max, launched in India last week, go on sale today via Oppo's Indian website, Amazon.in, Flipkart, and mainline retail outlets. The Oppo Find X10 Pro Max comes in Luna White and Titanium Grey in a single 12GB/512GB configuration, priced at INR199,999. Oppo Find X10 Pro Max's color options The Oppo Find X10, on the other hand, has three color options - Glacier Blue, Mist Grey, and Glow Coral.
